blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Practical remote sensing applications often require both understanding and generation capabilities for the same geographic scene. However, most existing methods address either understanding or generation in isolation, while existing unified remote sensing models' generative ability is limited to text-to-image. To bridge this gap, we propose Omni-RS, a unified framework supporting four remote sensing understanding tasks and five generation tasks. Specifically, we introduce the "Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training" strategy, which first adapts a multimodal large language model to remote sensing understanding and then uses its hidden states to guide a diffusion transformer for image generation. To enable joint learning across diverse generation tasks, we construct UniGen, a unified multi-task generation dataset, by organizing heterogeneous remote sensing data into a unified format. Furthermore, we introduce "Detailed Visual Conditioning", which uses visual conditions encoded by a VAE to guide the generation process, thereby supporting additional generation tasks that require reference images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Omni-RS performs exceptionally well in understanding tasks and has achieved outstanding results in a variety of generative tasks.
blocks.zh: 实用的遥感应用往往需要同一地貌的理解和生成能力。 然而,大多数现有方法要么孤立地解决理解或生成问题,而现有的统一遥感模型的基因能力仅限于文本到图像. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议Omni-RS,一个支持四项遥感理解任务和五代任务的统一框架。 具体来说,我们引入了"场景向导双层训练"策略,首先将多模式大语言模型用于遥感理解,再用其隐藏状态来引导一个扩散变压器来进行图像生成. 为了能够在不同世代任务中进行联合学习,我们通过将各种遥感数据组织成一个统一格式,构建一个统一的多任务生成数据集UniGen。 此外,我们引入了"详细视觉条件",它使用由一VAE编码的视觉条件来指导生成过程,从而支持需要参考图像的额外生成任务. 广泛的实验表明,Omni-RS在理解任务方面表现特别出色,并在各种遗传性任务中取得了突出成果.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Remote sensing (RS) imagery serves as a foundational pillar for Earth observation, powering critical downstream applications such as disaster response, environmental monitoring, and urban planning ( Van Westen, 2013 ; Li et al., 2020 ; Wellmann et al., 2020 ) . Powered by recent advances in deep learning, the field has witnessed remarkable progress across two distinct fronts: visual understanding has evolved from basic classification to complex visual question answering, while generative modeling has expanded from simple text-to-image synthesis to practical tasks like inpainting and cross-modal translation ( Maxwell et al., 2018 ; Lobry et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . However, these abilities have largely developed in their own isolated domains. In reality, real-world geospatial applications often require joint understanding and generation for a single scene, such as assessing damaged structures and inpainting missing imagery during disaster response. Consequently, developing a unified architecture that harmonizes multi-task RS understanding and generation is essential to addressing these intrinsically complementary needs.
blocks.zh: 遥感图像是地球观测的基础支柱,为救灾、环境监测和城市规划等下游关键应用提供动力(Van Westen,2013;Li等,2020; Wellmann等,2020)。 在近期深入学习进步的推动下,该领域在两个不同战线上取得了显著进展:视觉理解从基本分类演变为复杂的视觉问题回答,而基因模型化则从简单的文字到图像合成扩展为不作画和跨模式翻译等实际任务(Maxwell等,2018;Lobry等,2020;Chen等,2026). 然而,这些能力基本上在自己孤立的领域得到发展。 实际上,现实世界的地理空间应用往往需要共同理解和生成一个单一的场景,例如评估被破坏的结构,以及在救灾过程中为缺失的图像作油漆。 因此,发展统一架构,统一塞族共和国的多任务理解和生成,对于满足这些内在互补需要至关重要。

blocks.en: As illustrated on the left of Fig. 1 , existing remote sensing models generally fall into three categories: understanding-based, generation-based, and unified understanding-generation approaches. Understanding-based methods, such as GeoChat ( Kuckreja et al., 2024 ) and SkySenseGPT ( Luo et al., 2024 ) , leverage instruction tuning or scene graph reasoning to enable region-level grounding and spatial analysis. While effective for visual comprehension, these models lack generative capabilities. Conversely, generation-based methods focus on image synthesis; for instance, CRS-Diff ( Tang et al., 2024 ) integrates multi-modal conditions for controllable synthesis, and RSEdit ( Chen et al., 2026 ) adapts diffusion models for image editing. Nevertheless, these generative architectures cannot perform understanding tasks. Additionally, varying conditioning inputs across different generation tasks hinder joint training, leaving most methods tailored to a single task. Recently, Uni-RS ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) connected a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to a diffusion generator via learnable queries, achieving text-to-image synthesis alongside visual understanding. However, its generative capability is still restricted to text-to-image synthesis, failing to support tasks that require additional reference images, such as inpainting and layout controllable generation.
blocks.zh: 如图1左边所示,现有的遥感模型一般分为三类:基于理解、基于生成和统一的生成理解方法。 基于理解的方法,如GeoChat(Kuckreja等,2024年)和SkySenseGPT (Luo等, 2024),杠杆指令调取或场景图表推理,使区域层面的地上和空间分析成为可能. 这些模型虽然对视觉理解有效,但缺乏遗传能力。 相反,基于生成的方法侧重于图像合成;例如,CRS-Diff(Tang等,2024年)整合了可控合成的多模式条件,而RSEdit(Chen等,2026年)调整了图像编辑的传播模型. 然而,这些基因结构无法履行理解任务. 此外,不同代人任务中不同条件的投入妨碍了联合培训,使大多数方法适合单一任务。 最近,Uni-RS(Zhang等,2026年)通过可学习的查询,将一款多式大语言模型(MLLM)与扩散生成器相连接,实现了文本到图像的合成,同时实现了视觉理解. 然而,它的基因能力仍被限制在文本到图像的合成上,未能支持需要额外参考图像的任务,如印花和布局可控生成.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, unifying diverse remote sensing understanding and generation tasks within a single model still presents three key challenges. First, understanding and generation impose fundamentally different optimization requirements. Although both tasks rely on shared scene semantics, understanding aims to interpret visual content into sparse textual tokens, whereas generation focuses on synthesizing spatially consistent visual pixels. Jointly optimizing these heterogeneous objectives often leads to task interference during training, hindering the model from mastering both capabilities simultaneously. Second, existing generation datasets remain highly fragmented. For example, Git-10M ( Liu et al., 2025 ) provides image-text pairs tailored for text-to-image synthesis, while TerraGen ( Tang et al., 2026 ) couples images with spatial conditions for layout controllable generation. The disparity in conditioning inputs and supervision formats across datasets complicates their direct integration into a unified multi-task training framework. Third, existing unified models (e.g., Uni-RS) rely primarily on semantic guidance to steer generation. While such semantic representations effectively capture textual instructions, these representations ignore pixel-level spatial details, which limits the models’ ability to support generation tasks that require preserving the structure of the reference image, such as image inpainting and cross-modal transformation.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,将不同的遥感理解和生成任务统一在一个单一的模型中,仍然面临三大挑战。 第一,理解和生成提出了完全不同的优化要求。 虽然这两个任务都依赖于共享的场景语义,但理解旨在将视觉内容解读为稀有的文字符号,而生成则侧重于合成空间上一致的视觉像素. 联合优化这些不同的目标往往导致培训期间的任务干扰,妨碍模式同时掌握两种能力。 第二,现有数据集仍然高度零散。 例如,Git-10M (Liu等,2025年)提供为文本到图像合成而定制的图像-文本配对,而TerraGen(Tang等,2026年)配对的图像具有可布局可控生成的空间条件. 各种数据集在限定投入和监督格式方面的差异使其直接纳入统一的多任务培训框架变得复杂。 第三,现有的统一模型(如Uni-RS)主要依靠语义指导来引导生成. 虽然这种语义表述能有效地捕捉出文字指示,但这些表述忽略了像素级的空间细节,这限制了模型支持生成任务的能力,这些任务需要保留参考图像的结构,如图像涂装和跨模式转换等.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose Omni-RS, a unified framework for multi-task remote sensing understanding and generation. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , Omni-RS harmonizes four understanding and five generation tasks within a single architecture. First, to mitigate cross-task interference caused by conflicting optimization objectives, we propose a “Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training” strategy. Motivated by the insight that both understanding and generation rely on a prior comprehension of geospatial scenes, this strategy decouples semantic understanding from visual synthesis into two stages. In the first stage, the MLLM is trained on remote sensing understanding tasks to construct a robust domain-specific scene representation. In the second stage, the learned hidden representations from the MLLM are projected into conditional embeddings for the diffusion generator, effectively leveraging the model’s acquired scene awareness to guide image synthesis while mitigating cross-task interference. Second, to resolve dataset fragmentation, we construct UniGen, a unified remote sensing generation dataset that reorganizes heterogeneous data sources into a unified format. UniGen enables joint learning of multiple generation tasks across text-to-image synthesis, inpainting, outpainting, layout controllable generation, and cross-modal translation. Third, to overcome the loss of pixel-level spatial details in semantically guided generation, we introduce “Detailed Visual Conditioning”, which injects VAE latent features from reference images into the diffusion generator. This mechanism supplies more visual cues, enabling the model to better preserve visible content.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议Omni-RS,一个多任务遥感理解和生成的统一框架。 如图1所示,Omni-RS在单一架构内协调了4个理解和5个世代的任务。 第一,为减轻相互矛盾的优化目标所造成的跨任务干扰,我们提议一项“以事实为导向的双层培训”战略。 这一战略的动机是,理解和生成都依赖于对地理空间场景的事先理解,因此将语义理解从视觉合成解为两个阶段。 在第一阶段,MLLM接受了遥感理解任务的培训,以构建一个强大的针对具体域的场景代表. 在第二阶段,从MLLM中学习到的隐性表示被预测为扩散生成器的有条件嵌入,有效地利用了模型获得的场景意识来引导图像合成,同时减轻跨任务干扰. 第二,为了解决数据集的分解问题,我们构建了UniGen,一个统一的遥感生成数据集,将各种数据源重组为统一格式. UniGen 允许跨文本到图像合成,印花,出画,可布局可控生成,并跨模式翻译的多代任务联合学习. 第三,为克服像素级空间细节在成像引导生成中的损失,我们引入了“详细视觉条件”,将参考图像中的VAE潜在特性注入扩散生成器。 这种机制提供了更多的视觉提示,使模型能够更好地保存可见的内容.

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We propose Omni-RS , a unified remote sensing framework that harmonizes four understanding tasks and five generation tasks within a single architecture. Driven by a “ Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training ” strategy, Omni-RS leverages domain-specific scene understanding from an MLLM to effectively guide image generation. • We construct UniGen , a unified remote sensing generation dataset that reorganizes different data sources into a unified format, enabling joint multi-task learning across text-to-image synthesis, inpainting, outpainting, layout control, and cross-modal translation. • We introduce Detailed Visual Conditioning , a mechanism that injects VAE latents of reference images into the diffusion generator, effectively mitigating visual detail loss and ensuring high-fidelity structural preservation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Remote Sensing Multimodal Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.1 遥感多式联运

blocks.en: Early remote sensing understanding methods primarily relied on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for task-specific visual interpretation, such as image classification and pixel-level segmentation ( Li et al., 2018 ; Chauhan et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) . These approaches map remote sensing imagery to predefined categories or masks, providing effective solutions for individual perception tasks but offering limited support for flexible semantic interaction. With the development of large language models and vision-language learning, recent studies ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ) have begun to integrate remote sensing imagery with language models, enabling users to interact with remote sensing scenes through natural-language instructions. For example, Sun et al. (2025) enable models to describe changes in a scene using natural language, while Zi et al. (2025) require models to perform semantic, counting, and spatial reasoning in response to user queries.

blocks.en: 2.2 Remote Sensing Image Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 遥感图像生成

blocks.en: Early studies mainly employed generative adversarial networks (GANs) to synthesize remote sensing images ( Zhou et al., 2022 ; Tao et al., 2023 ) . With the development of diffusion models, recent methods have substantially improved the fidelity and diversity of generated remote sensing images. For example, Sebaq and ElHelw (2024) synthesize remote sensing scenes from natural-language descriptions, while Tang et al. (2025) further incorporate layouts as spatial conditions to constrain scene structures. In addition, image-conditioned generation has also been explored for tasks. For example, Sun et al. (2023) reconstruct missing regions conditioned on visible image content, while Li et al. (2022a) transform imagery between different remote sensing modalities.
blocks.zh: 早期的研究主要利用基因对抗网络(GANs)来合成遥感图像(周等,2022;陶等,2023.). 随着传播模型的开发,最近的方法大大提高了所生成的遥感图像的可靠性和多样性。 例如,Sebaq和ElHelw(2024年)从自然语言描述中合成了遥感场景,而Tang等人(2025年)进一步将布局作为空间条件来限制场景结构. 此外,还为任务探索了以图像为条件的生成. 例如,孙等. (2023)重建以可见图像内容为条件的缺失区域,而Li等. (2022a) 不同遥感方式之间的图像转换.

blocks.en: 2.3 Datasets for Remote Sensing Understanding And Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 遥感理解和生成数据集

blocks.en: The development of remote sensing multimodal understanding has benefited from increasingly mature data resources. Early datasets, such as RSICD, RSITMD, and RSVQA ( Lu et al., 2017 ; Yuan et al., 2022b ; Lobry et al., 2020 ) , primarily support individual tasks such as image captioning and visual question answering. More recently, datasets such as VRSBench and GeoChat ( Li et al., 2024a ; Kuckreja et al., 2024 ) have further integrated various understanding tasks into a unified format, laying the foundation for multimodal remote sensing understanding.
blocks.zh: 遥感多模式理解的发展得益于日益成熟的数据资源。 早期数据集如RSICD,RSITMD,和RSVQA(Lu等,2017;Yuan等,2022b;Lobry等,2020等)主要支持图像字幕和视觉问答等单个任务. 最近,VRS Bench和GeoChat(Li等,2024a;Kuckreja等,2024)等数据集进一步将各种理解任务整合到统一格式中,为多模式遥感理解奠定了基础.

blocks.en: In contrast, existing remote sensing generation datasets are still primarily constructed for specific generation tasks. For example, Git-10M ( Liu et al., 2025 ) provides image and text pairs for text-to-image generation, while RSEdit ( Chen et al., 2026 ) pairs source images with editing instructions for image editing. TerraGen ( Tang et al., 2026 ) further associates remote sensing images with layout-based spatial conditions to support controllable generation. However, these datasets differ substantially in their conditioning inputs and supervision formats, making them difficult to directly integrate for joint training across multiple generation tasks.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,现有的遥感生成数据集仍然主要为特定的生成任务而构建. 例如,Git-10M (Liu等,2025年)提供图像和文本对等,用于文本到图像生成,而RSEdit(Chen等,2026年)则提供有图像编辑指令的对等源图像. TerraGen (Tang等, 2026)进一步将遥感图像与基于布局的空间条件联系起来,以支持可控生成. 但是,这些数据集在调节投入和监督格式方面差异很大,难以直接整合用于跨多代任务的联合培训。

blocks.en: 2.4 Unified Understanding and Generation Models
blocks.zh: 2.4 统一理解和生成模式

blocks.en: Recent studies have increasingly explored integrating multimodal understanding and generation within a single model. For example, Wang et al. (2024) represent both images and text as discrete tokens and model them autoregressively within a shared sequence. Zhou et al. (2025) unify autoregressive language modeling and diffusion-based image generation within a single Transformer, jointly modeling discrete text tokens and continuous visual representations. Pan et al. (2025) and Wu et al. (2026) combine MLLMs with diffusion models, leveraging the semantic reasoning capability of the MLLM to provide conditions for high-fidelity image generation. More recently, Zhang et al. (2026) extend unified understanding and generation to remote sensing images. However, its generation capability remains limited to text-to-image generation and does not support more complex and practical image-conditioned tasks, such as image inpainting and modality translation. This limitation leaves the unified modeling of diverse remote sensing generation tasks largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究越来越多地探索将多式联运理解和生成纳入单一模式。 以王等为例. (2024)既代表图像又代表文本作为离散符号,并在共享序列内自相递减地建模. 周来等. (2025)将自递式语言模型和以扩散为基础的图像生成统一在一个"变形器"内,联合建模离散的文字符号和连续的视觉表现. 潘等 (2025)和吴等. (2026)结合了MLLMs与扩散模型,利用了MLLM的语义推理能力,为高真实度图像生成提供条件. 最近,张等(2026年)将统一理解和生成扩展至遥感影像. 然而,它的生成能力仍然局限于文本到图像生成,不支持更复杂,更实用的以图像为条件的任务,如图像涂装和模式翻译. 这一限制使得多种遥感发电任务的统一模型化基本上没有得到探讨。

blocks.en: 3 Dataset Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3 数据集管道

blocks.en: Existing remote sensing generation datasets are typically tailored for isolated tasks and seldom provide multiple generation tasks for the same geospatial scene. For instance, text-to-image datasets pair imagery with textual descriptions but they lack the reference images or task-specific instructions required for image inpainting. Likewise, datasets with spatial annotations or paired cross-modal observations provide disparate conditions that are not aligned across different tasks. To bridge this gap, we construct UniGen , a unified remote sensing dataset encompassing text-to-image, image inpainting, outpainting, controllable generation, and cross-modal translation. As illustrated in Figure 2 , UniGen pairs task-specific reference images with tailored instruction annotations, standardizing heterogeneous data sources into a unified triplet format { instruction , reference_image , output_image } \{\text{instruction},\text{reference\_image},\text{output\_image}\} .
blocks.zh: 现有的遥感生成数据集通常适合孤立的任务,很少为同一个地理空间场景提供多代任务. 例如,文本到图像数据集配有文字描述的图像,但它们缺乏图像插图所需的参考图像或特定任务指示. 同样,配有空间说明或配对式跨模式观测的数据集提供了不同条件,不能在不同任务之间保持一致。 为了弥合这一差距,我们构建了UniGen,一个统一的遥感数据集,包括文本到图像、图像涂装、外绘、可控生成和跨模式翻译。 如图2所示,UniGen将任务特定参考图像配对并附有定制的指令说明,将各种数据源标准化为统一的三重格式 {指示,参考-图像,输出-图像}}\ text{指示},\text{参考-图像},\text{输出-图像}。

blocks.zh: 图2:UniGen建设管线概况. 异地遥感数据重组为五代任务,由Quen-VL-Max提供标题和任务指令. 被破碎的箭头表示提供给SAM3进行涂装的附加分解提示.

blocks.en: To build a comprehensive benchmark, we aggregate complementary data sources including Git-10M ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , DIOR-R ( Cheng et al., 2022 ) , and WHU-OPT-SAR ( Li et al., 2022b ) . Specifically, Git-10M offers over 10 million globally distributed image–text pairs, providing diverse visual content and rich textual descriptions. DIOR-R contributes high-quality oriented bounding boxes and rotated object annotations, serving as a solid foundation for constructing precise spatial control conditions. Meanwhile, WHU-OPT-SAR supplies aligned RGB, NIR, and SAR observations at a 5 m spatial resolution across varied terrain, supporting cross-modal supervision for identical geographic regions. Leveraging these data sources, we derive task-specific instructions and reference image conditions around shared geospatial scenes to enable multi-task generation.
blocks.zh: 为了建立一个全面的基准,我们汇总了包括Git-10M在内的补充数据来源 (Liu等,2025年),DOOR-R(Cheng等,2022年),和WHU-OPT-SAR(Li等,2022b.). 具体地说,Git-10M提供了超过1000万个全球分布的图像-文本配对,提供了多样的视觉内容和丰富的文字描述. DOOR-R提供高质量的面向边框和旋转对象说明,为构建精确的空间控制条件提供坚实基础. 同时,WHU-OPT-SAR供应使RGB、国家清单报告和搜索和救援观测在5米空间分辨率不同地形之间保持一致,支持对相同地理区域进行跨模式监督。 利用这些数据源,我们围绕共享地理空间场景得出特定任务指令和参考图像条件,以促成多任务生成.

blocks.en:
The construction pipeline of the UniGen dataset is illustrated in Figure 2 . For text-to-image generation, we pair scene captions refined by Qwen-VL-Max ( Bai et al., 2023 ) with their corresponding images. For inpainting, Qwen-VL-Max generates subject-specific restoration instructions and segmentation prompts, which steer SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) to extract region masks; after filtering invalid masks, selected regions are removed to produce masked inputs while preserving original images as completion targets. For outpainting, we crop and pad images to construct partially observed canvases, pairing them with extension instructions and ground truth images. For controllable generation, to unify layout conditions with image conditions, we convert discrete annotations into rasterized color control maps. These control maps are generated by rendering DIOR-R’s bounding boxes or by coloring category masks from the inpainting task. The task instructions are then generated by Qwen-VL-Max. For cross-modal translation, RGB inputs are paired with corresponding NIR or SAR targets under modality-specific instructions. For all tasks, Qwen-VL-Max generates multi-task instructions with a consistent style based on the target image, control conditions, and task category. Detailed source statistics are provided in
Appendix A.1 .

blocks.en: 4.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 概览

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 3 , Omni-RS bridges a multimodal large language model (MLLM) with a diffusion transformer (DiT) via hidden states, harmonizing remote sensing visual understanding and multi-task image generation within a unified architecture. Built upon Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , the MLLM interprets visual-textual inputs for understanding tasks while simultaneously serving as a semantic encoder for downstream generation. Formally, we represent a unified data sample as a tuple ( u , r , y ) (u,r,y) , where u u denotes the text instruction, r r represents an optional reference image, and y y is the target output. For visual understanding, the MLLM processes the input image alongside instruction u u to autoregressively generate textual outputs. For generative tasks, the instruction u u and optional reference image r r are translated into unified semantic and visual tokens, respectively, which directly condition the DiT backbone to synthesize the target image y y .
blocks.zh: 如图3所说明的,Omni-RS通过隐藏状态搭建了多模式大型语言模型(MLLM)并配有扩散变压器(DIT),在统一的架构内协调遥感视觉理解和多任务图像生成. 由Quen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct(Bai等,2025年)所建,MLLM为理解任务解释视觉-文字输入,同时作为下游一代的语义编码器. 形式上,我们作为tuple (u, r, y) (u, r, y) 代表一个统一的数据样本,其中u u 表示文本指令,r 表示一个可选的参考图像,y 为目标输出. 为了视觉理解,MLLM会将输入图像与指令u u一起处理,以自动地生成文字输出. 对于基因任务,指令u u和可选参考图像r r分别被翻译为统一的语义符号和视觉符号,直接对DiT主干线进行条件来合成目标图像y y.

blocks.en: 4.2 Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training
blocks.zh: 4.2 场景指导双层培训

blocks.en: We observe that both remote sensing visual understanding and image generation rely on prior geographic scene modeling to capture high-level semantics and spatial topology before performing their respective tasks. Based on this key insight, we propose a novel “ Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training ” strategy. Specifically, this approach first adapts the MLLM to acquire domain-specific remote sensing knowledge, and subsequently leverages its frozen hidden states as conditional guidance to steer the DiT for multi-task image generation.
blocks.zh: 我们观测到,遥感视觉理解和图像生成都依赖于之前的地貌模型,在完成各自的任务之前能够捕捉高层次的语义和空间地貌. 基于这一关键见解,我们提出了一个小说“场景指导双层培训”战略。 具体地说,这种方法首先使MLLM适应获得特定域的遥感知识,而后利用其被冻结的隐藏状态作为有条件的指导来引导DiT用于多任务图像生成.

blocks.en: We initialize the MLLM backbone with Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct and fine-tune it on remote sensing understanding benchmarks. During this stage, the base MLLM backbone and the Diffusion Transformer remain frozen. Through supervision on dense scene descriptions, object categorizations, and spatial reasoning, the MLLM effectively aligns its semantic embedding space with remote sensing domain characteristics.

blocks.en: In the second stage, we freeze the MLLM in Stage I and optimize the DiT, which is initialized from the pretrained OmniGen2 ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , using parameter-efficient LoRA adapters on the proposed UniGen dataset. Given a text instruction u u , the adapted MLLM extracts multi-layer hidden states, which are mapped into semantic condition tokens S S . Crucially, these tokens not only accurately convey the intent of the instruction u u , but also inject the geospatial prior knowledge acquired in Stage I into the DiT. For tasks requiring reference images, S S is augmented with visual tokens V V derived via the Detailed Visual Conditioning module.

blocks.en: 4.3 Detailed Visual Conditioning
blocks.zh: 4.3 详细的视觉条件

blocks.en: While semantic tokens capture high-level task intent, they inherently struggle to preserve the fine-grained visual details of reference images. Generative tasks in remote sensing, such as image inpainting and modality translation, require strict adherence to the visual context and structural constraints provided by a source image. To address this limitation, we propose Detailed Visual Conditioning to explicitly inject reference visual priors into the generative backbone.
blocks.zh: 虽然语义符号捕捉出高层次的任务意图,但它们在本质上为保存参考图像精细的视觉细节而挣扎. 遥感中的遗传性任务,如图像油漆和模式翻译,需要严格遵守由源图像提供的视觉上下文和结构约束. 为了解决这一限制,我们提议详细视觉条件,明确将参考视觉前科注入基因骨干.

blocks.en: Given a reference image r r , a pretrained VAE encoder extracts its dense latent representation, which is subsequently tokenized and projected into visual tokens: V = P v ​ ( V ​ A ​ E ​ ( r ) ) , V=P_{v}(VAE(r)), (3) where P v P_{v} denotes the visual tokenization and linear projection layer. This pathway bypasses lossy textual compression, directly supplying spatially organized visual tokens alongside instruction-derived semantic tokens S S .

Fed with X X and timestep t t , the DiT blocks model all cross-token interactions via full self-attention to predict the target velocity v θ ​ ( X , t ) v_{\theta}(X,t) .

This conditioning pathway accommodates diverse visual inputs across tasks in a unified interface. Specifically, the reference image r r defined in Section 4.1 adapts to specific task requirements. For image inpainting and outpainting, r r provides the unmasked context; for controllable generation, r r introduces color maps for spatial layout positions; for cross-modal translation, r r supplies structural configurations from the source modality to ensure geometric consistency in the target output.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集

blocks.en: For training, we use GeoChat ( Kuckreja et al., 2024 ) to adapt the MLLM for remote sensing understanding in Stage I and UniGen to train the generation branch in Stage II. Furthermore, we evaluate visual understanding on RSVQA-LR ( Lobry et al., 2020 ) , VRSBench-VQA ( Li et al., 2024a ) , and the GeoChat region understanding benchmark ( Kuckreja et al., 2024 ) . For image generation, text-to-image generation is evaluated on RSICD ( Lu et al., 2017 ) , layout-controllable generation on DIOR-R ( Cheng et al., 2022 ) , and image completion (inpainting, outpainting) along with cross-modal translation (RGB → \rightarrow NIR, RGB → \rightarrow SAR) on the test split of our proposed UniGen dataset. Detailed descriptions and formulations of all evaluation metrics are provided in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 在培训方面,我们利用GeoChat(Kuckreja等,2024年)在第一阶段和UniGen对MLLM进行遥感理解,在第二阶段培训生成分支。 此外,我们评价关于RSVQA-LR的视觉理解(Lobry等,2020年),VRS Bench-VQA (Li等,2024a),和GeoChat区域理解基准(Kuckreja等,2024.). 对于图像生成,文本到图像生成在RSICD(Lu等,2017年),DOOR-R(Cheng等,2022年)上可被布局控制生成,图像完成(平面,出相)与跨模式翻译(RGB →\正右RONA,RGB →\正右右RAR)一起在我们提议的UniGen数据集的测试分出上进行评估. 所有评价指标的详细描述和表述载于附录A.4。

blocks.en: 5.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 5.2 执行细节

blocks.en: Following Section 4.2 , we fine-tune the MLLM with rank-16 LoRA for 152K steps at a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} in Stage I. In Stage II, we freeze the MLLM adapted in Stage I and train the diffusion transformer with rank-128 LoRA for 100K steps, using learning rates of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} for the first 55K steps and 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} thereafter. Both stages are trained on two NVIDIA A100 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 继第4.2节之后,我们将MLLM与16级LORA对152K步骤进行微调,在第一阶段的学习率为1×10-4 1\times 10^{4}。 在第二阶段,我们冻结了第一阶段的MLLM并用128级LORA对扩散变压器进行100K步骤的训练,在前55K步骤和之后的5×10-5分10^{5分的学习率为1×10−4分10^{4分。 两个阶段都接受了两个NVIDIA A100 GPU的培训.

blocks.en: Qualitative Visual Comprehension. Figure 4 showcases the visual comprehension of Omni-RS across varying ground scales and semantic granularities. In image captioning (left column), our model not only generates holistic scene narratives but also captures the spatial topology, such as the central runway surrounded by trees. In region-level perception (middle column), Omni-RS focuses strictly on the prompt-specified bounding box, accurately identifying the narrow infrastructure as a dam and classifying the overarching scene as rural. Moreover, the right column highlights its capacity for fine-grained object enumeration (two aircraft) and relative spatial reasoning (localizing the planes to the left side of the road). These results verify that our Stage I adaptation successfully injects robust spatial awareness and geospatial priors into the MLLM backbone.

blocks.en: Quantitative Evaluation. Tables 1 , 3 , and 5 quantitatively evaluate the visual understanding capabilities of Omni-RS across diverse benchmarks. Under zero-shot evaluation on RSVQA-LR (Table 1 ), Omni-RS achieves a state-of-the-art average accuracy of 92.52 % 92.52\% , consistently outperforming existing specialized remote sensing methods and multimodal baselines. On VRSBench (Table 3 ), our 3B-parameter model obtains 49.89 % 49.89\% accuracy, noticeably surpassing substantially larger models such as GeoChat-7B ( + 3.35 % +3.35\% ) and GeoLLaVA-8K ( + 0.99 % +0.99\% ), demonstrating competitive parameter efficiency and effective domain adaptation. In the fine-grained region understanding benchmark (Table 5 ), although Omni-RS slightly trails the in-domain supervised GeoChat-7B, it substantially outperforms general-domain baselines like MiniGPT-v2 by a wide margin (e.g., 85.3 85.3 vs. 32.1 32.1 in ROUGE-1), confirming its solid region-level localization and comprehension capabilities.

blocks.en: Qualitative Generation Fidelity. Figure 5 visually illustrates the multi-task generative capabilities of Omni-RS across diverse scenarios within a single unified architecture. Beyond text-to-image synthesis, for inpainting and outpainting, Omni-RS enables continuous landscape features, such as waterways and road grids, to extend naturally across mask boundaries. Furthermore, in cross-modal translation and controllable generation, the model reliably preserves structural topologies while simultaneously accommodating sensor-specific physical properties and categorical spatial constraints. Additional comparisons and large-scale outpainting results are detailed in Appendix A.2 and A.3 .

blocks.en:
Quantitative Evaluation across Generative Tasks. The quantitative results in Tables 3 , 5 , 6 , and 7 validate the effectiveness and structural fidelity of Omni-RS across varied synthesis tasks.
In text-to-image generation (Table 3 ), Omni-RS attains the lowest FID of 21.90 21.90 alongside a competitive CLIP score ( 24.85 24.85 ) on RSICD. These results demonstrate that incorporating reference-conditioned generation tasks via Detailed Visual Conditioning does not compromise the text-to-image synthesis capability.
In layout-controllable generation (Table 5 ) and cross-modal translation (Table 6 ), Omni-RS excels at maintaining spatial layouts and geometric structures. Specifically, the leading Classification Accuracy Score ( 78.77 78.77 CAS) on DIOR-R verifies strict adherence to spatial bounding constraints, while the superior PSNR in RGB to NIR/SAR translation confirms that our visual conditioning pathway robustly preserves macroscopic ground geometry across distinct sensor domains.
Furthermore, for inpainting and outpainting (Table 7 ), our framework achieves significant performance gains in both inpainting (reducing LPIPS by 0.12 0.12 compared to the second-best baseline) and outpainting ( 35.33 35.33 FID), confirming that our injection of VAE latent tokens allows for the preservation of unmasked regions and ensures seamless continuity at the boundaries.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: In this paper, we presented Omni-RS , a unified multimodal framework that seamlessly bridges remote sensing visual understanding and multi-task image generation within a single architecture. By harnessing an MLLM as the universal task planner and conditioning engine alongside a DiT backbone, Omni-RS effectively eliminates the barrier between perception and synthesis in Earth observation. Furthermore, our proposed two-stage training paradigm, complemented by the newly curated UniGen benchmark, establishes a strong baseline for complex tasks such as layout-controllable generation, high-fidelity inpainting/outpainting, and cross-modal RGB-to-SAR/NIR translation. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that Omni-RS achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance across different benchmark tasks.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了Omni-RS——一个统一的多模式框架,它将遥感视觉理解和多任务图像生成在单一建筑中无缝地连接起来。 通过利用MLLM作为通用的任务规划员和与DiT主干线并列的调节引擎,Omni-RS有效地消除了地球观测中认知和合成之间的障碍. 此外,我们提议的两阶段培训模式得到新制定的UniGen基准的补充,为诸如可布局控制的生成、高真度的涂料/外涂和跨模式的RGB-SAR/NIR翻译等复杂任务确立了强有力的基线。 广泛的定量和定性评价表明,Omni-RS在不同基准任务中取得了最新或有竞争力的业绩。

blocks.en: Although Omni-RS unifies multiple tasks in remote sensing understanding and generation, the model’s understanding task output is currently limited to discrete text sequences and lacks pixel-level visual understanding capabilities, such as image segmentation. In future research, we plan to leverage the powerful open-domain reasoning capabilities of MLLMs to extend the understanding task to open-vocabulary segmentation and reference segmentation. This will further advance the development of a comprehensive remote sensing model that unifies text, masks, and pixels within a single framework.
blocks.zh: 虽然Omni-RS统一了遥感理解和生成中的多个任务,但模型的理解任务输出目前仅限于离散的文本序列,并缺乏像素级的视觉理解能力,如图像分解. 在未来的研究中,我们计划利用MLLMs强大的开放域推理能力来将理解任务扩展到开放-vobulary分和参考分. 这将进一步推动在单一框架内统一文本、口罩和像素的综合遥感模型的发展。

blocks.en: • Text-to-Image Generation (Rows a–c): Omni-RS accurately captures fine-grained spatial configurations specified in the prompts, such as the regular layout of houses surrounding the stadium and the smooth meandering geometry of the dark green river. blocks.en: A.3 Continuous Outpainting for Large-Scale Geospatial Landscapes.

blocks.en: In practical Earth observation scenarios, downstream applications frequently require extrapolating wide-area, continuous geographical landscapes beyond a single sensor footprint. To evaluate the structural stability and long-range coherence of Omni-RS, we conduct multi-step continuous outpainting starting from a localized input patch ( 256 × 256 256\times 256 ), as illustrated in Figure 8 .
blocks.zh: 在实际的地球观测设想中,下游的应用经常需要外推超出单一传感器足迹的广域连续地貌。 为了评估Omni-RS的结构稳定性和远程一致性,我们从一个局部输入补丁(256×256/256\times 256)开始,进行多步骤的连续外绘,如图8所示。

blocks.en: Remarkably, Omni-RS progressively expands the initial crop into an ultra-wide panoramic remote sensing scene with a final canvas size of 2560 × 1024 2560\times 1024 . Throughout this iterative generation process, the complex meandering geometry and branch topologies of the central river system remain globally coherent and physically plausible. Furthermore, the surrounding wetland vegetation, sediment textures, and subtle radiometric transitions extend naturally across multiple expansion steps without introducing noticeable stitching boundaries, blurriness, or catastrophic structural collapse. This qualitative demonstration underscores the model’s robust spatial generalization and its remarkable ability to preserve long-range contextual continuity in megapixel-scale remote sensing synthesis.

blocks.en: A.4 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: A.4 评价计量

blocks.en: For understanding, we report VQA accuracy and ROUGE-1 (R-1), ROUGE-L (R-L) ( Lin, 2004 ) , and METEOR (MR) ( Banerjee and Lavie, 2005 ) for region understanding. Text-to-image generation is evaluated using Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) and CLIP similarity ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . Inpainting and outpainting are evaluated using FID, Kernel Inception Distance (KID) ( Bińkowski et al., 2018 ) , and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . For controllable generation, we report YOLO Score ( Li et al., 2021 ) and Classification Accuracy Score (CAS) ( Ravuri and Vinyals, 2019 ) . Cross-modal translation is evaluated using MAE, Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) for RGB-to-NIR, and MAE, RMSE, and PSNR for RGB-to-SAR.
blocks.zh: 为了了解情况,我们报告VQA精确度和ROUGE-1(R-1)、ROUGE-L(R-L)(Lin,2004年)和METEOR(MR)(Banerjee和Lavie,2005年),以便区域了解。 文本到图像生成使用Fréchet Inception距离(FID)(Heusel等,2017年)和CLIP相似性(Radford等,2021年)来评价. 通过FID,Kernel Inception District(KID)(Binkowski等,2018年),以及学习感知图像补丁相似性(LPIPS)(Zhang等,2018年)来评价印花和出花. 对于可控生成,我们报告YOLO分数(Li等,2021年)和分类精确分数(CAS)(Ravuri和Vinyals,2019年). 使用MAE,结构相似性指数(SSIM)(Wang等,2004年)和峰信号对噪比(PSNR)对RGB对NIR,以及MAE,RMSE,PSNR对RGB对SAR,来评价跨模式翻译.
